title: How to Verify and Seed Bank Account with Aadhaar DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer)
issuingAuthority: Authorized Bank Branch & National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) / UIDAI
requiredDocuments: Bank Passbook copy showing active Savings Account (in student's name, not minor/joint unless permitted)
Aadhaar Card copy (with mobile linked for OTP)
NPCI Aadhaar Mandate & Consent Form (duly signed)

steps.title: Check Current NPCI DBT Seeding Status
steps.description: Log into resident.uidai.gov.in/bank-mapper or use myAadhaar portal to check 'Bank Seeding Status'. If inactive or unlinked, proceed to step 2.

steps.title: Submit Mandate Form at Bank
steps.description: Visit your bank home branch and submit the official NPCI DBT Consent Form requesting Aadhaar mapper linkage.

steps.title: Bank Official Verification & Confirmation
steps.description: Bank clerk updates core banking system (CBS) and pushes account details to NPCI mapper. Obtain stamped acknowledgement receipt.

validityPeriod: Continuous while bank account remains active and KYC updated.

sourceRef.portal: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Bharat Portal, Govt. of India
